subject: game-development
intro: Game development leads into the studios and platforms of interactive entertainment — the programmers, artists, designers and producers who ship playable worlds.

roles.title: Software Developers
roles.what: Research, design and develop computer and network software or specialised utility programs, analysing user needs and building software solutions — in games, most visibly the engines, tools and netcode players never see.
roles.where: The engines and game loop unit — entity-component systems, physics and collision — and game AI with state machines, behaviour trees and A-star pathfinding are programming work under this title's umbrella.

roles.title: Special Effects Artists and Animators
roles.what: Create special effects or animations using film, video, computers or other electronic tools and media for products such as computer games, movies, music videos and commercials.
roles.where: Graphics and rendering — sprites, meshes, shaders, lighting pipelines and frame budgets — plus game mathematics with quaternions, rotation and interpolation are the exact skills behind game art and animation.

roles.title: Producers and Directors
roles.entry: Bachelor's degree plus years of experience
roles.what: Produce or direct productions for entertainment, information or instruction — in games, running the creative decisions, schedules and cross-discipline teams that turn a design document into a shipped title.
roles.where: The production, publishing and business unit — agile game production, monetisation models, the publishing ecosystem — plus design documents and prototyping from the foundations unit are this role's core material.

roles.title: Graphic Designers
roles.what: Design or create graphics to meet specific commercial or promotional needs — packaging, displays, logos and, in games, the interfaces, key art and marketing assets players meet first.
roles.where: The audio, UI/UX and polish unit — game feel, juice and accessibility — and level and narrative design teach the player-facing visual judgement this career applies to interfaces and campaigns.
